mapper.delete: delete from t_cruise_task_del where task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update:
update t_cruise_task_del a a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.del_time = #{delTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, a.create_time = #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
where a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select a.task_id, a.del_time, a.create_time from t_cruise_task_del a where 1 = 1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} limit 1
select a.task_id, a.del_time, a.create_time from t_cruise_task_del a where 1 = 1 and a.del_time >= #{dayBefore, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.del_time <= #{dayAfter, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
